chunks: From him, from Ahmad, from Musa ibn al-Qasim and Abi Qatadah, from Ali ibn Ja'far, from his brother Musa ibn Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about salat al-kusuf: is qada' due upon one who leaves it? He said: If it passes you by, then there is no qada' upon you.

key_terms.تَرَكَهَا: left it or did not perform it
key_terms.فَاتَتْكَ: it passed you by or was missed by you
key_terms.قَضَاءٌ: make-up performance of a missed act of worship

ai.seo_question: Is qada' required if someone misses salat al-kusuf?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling of salat al-kusuf when it has been missed. Imam Musa ibn Ja'far عليه السلام states that if the prayer has passed a person by, then no qada' is required upon him. It is a concise juridical report related to rulings of worship.
